title: Occupational Safety and Health Act – OSHA (Luật An toàn Sức khỏe Nghề nghiệp)

versions.text:
Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSH Act) – 29 USC §651 et seq.
General Duty Clause §654(a)(1): Employers must provide workplace free from recognized hazards. OSHA Standards: 29 CFR Part 1910 (General Industry), Part 1926 (Construction). Inspections: §657. Citations and penalties: §666. Whistleblower protection: §660(c).
